patterns: Core one-liner: who distributes taxes / recommends grants-in-aid principles - the Finance Commission (Art. 280, 275).
Share-percentage recall per FC is a favourite: 10th 29%, 11th 29.5%, 13th 32%, 14th 42%, 15th 41%.
APPSC asks 'which is NOT a function of the FC' (income-expenditure accounts, APPSC-G2 2017).
App carries many 2025-26 budget/ES data items; PYQs stick to constitutional functions and headline percentages.
